author: TeIq
content: Delivered: PatternSelector typed enum (ImageHashCluster / AccountCohort / AnomalyBucket). POST /api/pattern-actions propose handler: validates reasoning, resolves selector to affected subjects, inserts pattern_actions header, auto-executes if below cosign_threshold else returns requires_cosign=true. POST /api/pattern-actions/:id/cosign: senior role check (Admin or SeniorModerator), self-cosign forbidden, records signature + executes in single sqlx Transaction. Migration adds pattern_actions + pattern_action_signatures + pattern_action_subjects tables. PatternActionRepo trait + PgPatternActionRepo impl. PatternActionsConfig with POLARIS_PATTERN_ACTIONS_COSIGN_THRESHOLD env override (default 100). Router threads cfg from main.rs. Per-subject Action rows inserted in same transaction as subject linkage — atomic all-or-nothing, no UPDATE on actions table. tests/pattern_actions.rs with 5 scenarios proving below-threshold auto + above-threshold cosign + self-cosign 403 + non-senior 403 + failure-injection rollback all pass against testcontainers Postgres 16.
